messages:
Eva: Heads up — ACME Corp's latest on-prem invoice (INV-88912) split the annual platform fee across two line items, which is causing our AR upload to reject. Can billing help reconcile? :eyes:
Sam: Thanks Eva — can you paste the invoice lines? is this the renewal true-up or the commit monthly invoice?
Eva: Renewal true-up. Contract had a fixed platform fee of $120k/yr on the S3 commit, but invoice shows 60k and 62k (different GL codes).
Maria: tagging myself — I own the ACME relationship. We did a mid-contract addendum in Nov, wonder if that triggered a split. Customer expects one platform fee line.
Devin: I pulled the usage accounting — the commit reconciliation shows the commit credit applied, then we had a spike in host counts that should have been invoiced as overage, not split platform fee. Quick CSV snippet: ```commit_id,period,commit_amount,overage_usd,platform_fee_usd
CMT-2023-11,2024-01,100000,8000,120000
CMT-2023-11,2024-02,0,0,0
``` Looks like billing exported platform_fee as two transactions during migration.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-88912 created by billing-worker at 1976543205. Payment terms: Net30.
Sam: If GL codes differ we can't auto-apply to the AR bucket. We need a finance-approved journal entry or a credit memo + corrected invoice. Which is less customer-disruptive?
Maria: Customer prefers minimal paperwork. If we can issue a small correcting invoice that nets to the same total (single platform fee line) that'd be ideal. They want the renewal amount to match contract.
Eva: Is there any risk of double-billing if we issue a correcting invoice?
Devin: No double-bill risk if we void the erroneous invoice lines and reissue one consolidated line. I'll attach the reconciliation slice here for reference.
Sam: Routing to finance ops — @Leo FYI need approval for credit path. Proposed steps: 1) Void INV-88912 lines for platform fee 2) Issue corrected invoice INV-88912-REV with single platform fee line 3) Create journal entry to move GL bucket and update AR upload. Estimated time: 2 business days.
Leo: +1 on the path. Need PR number for the journal entry and ops approval. Maria pls confirm that ACME okay with reissue.
Maria: Confirmed with ACME on call — they prefer reissue. They asked we preserve invoice number in memo for their finance team.
Sam: Ok — Finance ops: please create credit memo CM-472 and reissue as INV-88912-R1. Tag PR-7043 on the journal. Also add note: "Consolidated platform fee per contract amendment Nov 2023".
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-472 created at 1976545120 by billing-worker.
Eva: Thx — once journal is posted can someone confirm back here so I can re-run the AR upload?
Sam: I'll update when posted. Posting ETA end of day.
Devin: Leaving a quick note for records: reconcile script used `reconcile_commit.py --commit CMT-2023-11 --export-lines` in case we need to reproduce CSV.
Leo: Journal PR-7043 posted and linked to CM-472 at 1976546600. Finance ops confirmed GL change from PLAT-FEE-DEV to PLAT-FEE-REV.
Sam: Posted and AR upload succeeded after reissue. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
Maria: ACME acknowledged receipt and will mirror in their AP — thanks team.
Eva: Great — thanks everyone.
Leo: Filing internal note for renewal process: avoid splitting platform fee when migration flags are set. Will propose a small billing rule change. :memo:
